## Summary
All 15 nightly failures (2026-10-05, SHA 6476c92) were the same `041-dynamic-ui` snapshot diff across Linux, macOS and Windows on R 4.2-4.6. The updated shiny build no longer emits `data-date-dates-disabled="null"` on the date input. This is an equivalent change, so all of it was accepted.

## Minute Changes Accepted
- `041-dynamic-ui` `mytest/021.json` for linux, mac and windows on R 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5 and 4.6 (15 snapshots). The only difference is that the redundant `data-date-dates-disabled="null"` attribute is gone from the rendered `dynamic` date input HTML. The blob hash is identical across all 15 files.
- `inst/apps/sysinfo-{linux,mac,win}-4.{2..6}.txt` (15 files). Generated metadata churn only: run date, package versions (igraph, listenv, renv, rsconnect, s2, shiny, tm, XML), Chrome patch version and gha_image.

## Needs Human Review
None

## Commands Run
- `Rscript -e 'shinycoreci::fix_snaps(sha = "6476c92", ask_apps = FALSE, ask_branches = FALSE, ask_if_not_main = FALSE)'`: passed. All 15 patches applied cleanly.
- `git status --short` and `git diff -- inst/apps`: passed. 30 files changed, all reviewed.
